title: Verify selected iOS 16.5 eSIM frontend and hardware-profile compatibility
acceptance: Inventory actual locally supplied OS components, version and digests without committing Apple files or silently switching the approved first OS
Determine whether the selected iPhone X identity/image includes the required eSIM frontend and matching CommCenter/IOKit ABI; a later eSIM-capable reference is not assumed compatible
Record a concrete adaptation/profile decision and host validation; missing binaries or indirect documentation are not a compatibility pass
steps: Accept explicit local inputs and verify provenance
Inspect frontend capabilities and ABI boundaries without executing or downloading Apple binaries
Publish the evidence required before native eSIM lifecycle qualification
